title: What Is Google AI Mode and How to Test Your Business in It
h1: What is Google AI Mode and how to test your business in it
desc: Google AI Mode is a conversational search experience that answers with AI and shows source links. Learn what it is and how to check whether your business appears.
lead: AI Mode is a conversational way to search on Google: you ask, it answers with AI, you follow up, and it shows links to sources. Here is how to find out whether your business shows up.
body:
I will answer in order: what it is, why it matters to you, and how to test your own business in it without paid tools.

What is AI Mode?

It is a way of using Google where you type a full question in your own words, get an answer written by AI, and see links to the sources underneath. You can then ask a follow-up and the conversation continues. For the short definition, see AI Mode in the glossary.

It differs from AI Overviews, which are summaries that can appear inside normal search results for some queries. AI Mode is a conversation the user chooses to open.

Why it matters to your business

A customer may start broad and narrow down: "best accounting firm in Jeddah", then "which suits a small company?", then "how much does it cost?". Every follow-up is another chance for your name to appear or not. In my work with Qoyod, I recorded that Google AI Mode listed it first for best cloud accounting software in Saudi Arabia. That was one question at one time, not a promise it will repeat for you.

What Google says

Per Google, a page can appear as a supporting link in these features if it is indexed and eligible to be shown with a snippet, and no special markup is needed. How links are chosen in each answer is not public, and answers can differ between users and countries.

How to test your business in AI Mode

  1. Write five customer questions the way customers phrase them. Example: "What is the best family restaurant in Riyadh?"
  2. Open AI Mode from Google search if it is available for your country and account. If not, run the same questions in other AI tools.
  3. Ask the question, then two follow-ups. For example "which is cheapest?" and "which is closest to me?". Note whether your name stays in the conversation.
  4. Record the result in a sheet: were you mentioned, how were you described, which links appeared, and who was named instead.
  5. Repeat a few days later. Answers change, so one try is not enough to judge.

What to do with the result

  • Not mentioned: check that your pages are indexed, your business description is clear and consistent, and you have a page that answers the question directly.
  • Mentioned wrongly: find the page or profile saying it and correct it. I did this at Forlanso, where AI tools classified it as a freelance marketplace.
  • Mentioned correctly: keep your pages current and add answers to the likely follow-up questions.

Start now

To start with ready questions for your business type, try the free visibility test, which has a link to try each question in Google AI Mode. For the full Qoyod result, read the case study.

I cannot promise that AI Mode will mention you. I can help you learn where you stand and what to improve.
faq: Is AI Mode available in every country?
Availability differs by country and account. If you cannot see it, test the same questions in other AI tools.
What is the difference between AI Mode and AI Overviews?
Overviews are summaries that can appear inside normal results for some queries. AI Mode is a conversation the user chooses and continues with follow-ups.
Do I need special markup to appear?
Google says it does not require special markup. Pages need to be indexed and eligible to show a snippet.
